title: feat(layout,app-shell,console): the console top bar is 48 px in every frame (objectui#12639)
body:
Fixes #12639

Clause-②: no

## What changes

Every console frame draws its top bar at 48 px (`h-12`), the height both approved artboards draw (`Home.html` and `AppBar.html`, `header style="height:48px"`). It was 56 px (`h-14`). The height is one value everywhere, so the bar holds still between Home, an app, the organization pages, `/ai` and the `/studio` landing.

### Six bars, not five

The card lists five frames. A census of every source that mounts `AppHeader`, and of every class literal that carries the bar's `sticky top-0 z-30` signature, finds a sixth: the `/studio` landing frame (`StudioLanding` in `apps/console/src/components/StudioRoute.tsx`). It drew the same 56 px bar around `AppHeader`'s `studio` variant, so it changes too. Studio's package builder (`StudioDesignSurface`) draws its own header from `STUDIO_HEADER` in `studio-tokens.ts`. That header is already 48 px from `sm` up (objectui#12459 and objectui#12509), so it is unchanged.

| Frame | File | How it draws the bar now |
|---|---|---|
| Inside every app | `packages/layout/src/AppShell.tsx` (`ConsoleLayout` passes `AppHeader` to it as `navbar`) | a literal, equal to `CONSOLE_TOP_BAR` |
| Home | `packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomeLayout.tsx` | reads `CONSOLE_TOP_BAR` |
| Organization list | `packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/OrganizationsLayout.tsx` | reads `CONSOLE_TOP_BAR` |
| One organization | `packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/manage/OrganizationLayout.tsx` | reads `CONSOLE_TOP_BAR` |
| Full-page assistant, `/ai` | `packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx` | `cn(CONSOLE_TOP_BAR, 'bg-background/95 backdrop-blur')`, which keeps its translucent background |
| `/studio` landing | `apps/console/src/components/StudioRoute.tsx` | a literal, equal to `CONSOLE_TOP_BAR` |

### One definition, and why two copies stay literal

`CONSOLE_TOP_BAR` lives in a new internal module, `packages/app-shell/src/layout/consoleTopBar.ts`. The package entry does not export it. The four app-shell frames read it.

The other two frames cannot read it without a new export:

- `@object-ui/layout`'s `AppShell` sits upstream of app-shell, so it cannot import from it.
- `apps/console` could reach the constant only if `@object-ui/app-shell` exported it.

A new export would add a public symbol to a published package for a constant only first-party code reads, and `Clause-②` would become `yes`. So those two frames keep the class as a literal, and the pin holds each one equal to the constant, character for character. The report gives the trade-off.

## Offset census (Target 2)

Scanned: `packages/layout/src`, `packages/app-shell/src`, `apps/console/src`, `packages/components/src` and `packages/plugin-*/src`. The spellings searched were `top-14`, `scroll-mt-14`, `3.5rem`, `56px`, `calc(100vh / 100svh / 100dvh …)`, `h-svh`, `min-h-svh`, `h-screen`, `h-dvh`, sticky or fixed `top-N`, and named header-height constants.

| Site | Spelling | Offsets from this bar? | Decision |
|---|---|---|---|
| `UnifiedSidebar`, the app sidebar's fixed desktop column | `!top-14 !h-[calc(100svh-3.5rem)]` | yes | Now `CONSOLE_BELOW_TOP_BAR`, which is `!top-12 !h-[calc(100svh-3rem)]`. It sits beside the bar in `consoleTopBar.ts`, and the pin derives both numbers from the bar's `h-N`. |
| `AppShell` frame: `h-svh` provider, `shrink-0` bar, `flex-1 min-h-0` row | a flex chain | no fixed number | None. The row takes whatever height the bar leaves. |
| Home and organization layouts: `min-h-svh` column, `sticky top-0` bar | a flex column | no | None. |
| `AiChatPage`: `h-svh` column | a flex column | no | None. |
| `DocPage` TOC: `sticky top-20 max-h-[calc(100vh-6rem)]` | offsets from `DocShell`'s own `py-3` header | no: the doc routes mount `DocShell`, not the console bar | None. |
| `ActivityFeed` list: `max-h-[calc(100vh-8rem)]` | inside a full-height right `Sheet` | no: the sheet covers the bar | None. |
| `TranslationPreview`: `min-h-[3.5rem]` | a preview row's minimum height | no | None. |
| `app-shell/src/styles.css` print rules | hide the bar by selector | no height involved | None. |
| `header-bar` renderer: `h-14 sm:h-16` | the `header-bar` schema block | no: a page-level metadata block, not the console bar | None. |
| `@object-ui/runner`'s `LayoutRenderer`: `h-14` header | the runner's own app frame | not a console frame | None. |

## Bar contents at 48 px (Target 3)

The bar has no vertical padding (`px-2 sm:px-4` only) and centers its row, so any control up to 48 px fits. Heights read from the classes:

- product mark: 28 px (`h-7`);
- sidebar trigger: 28 px (`h-7`);
- app pill: about 30 px (a 22 px `AppMark` plus `py-1`);
- preview chip: about 20 px (`text-[10px]` plus `py-0.5`);
- search field: 32 px (`h-8`);
- search, assistant, bell and help icon buttons: 32 px (`h-8 w-8`);
- avatar button: 32 px (`h-8`);
- presence avatars: 24 px.

No control is taller than 48 px. The tallest, at 32 px, leaves 8 px above and below. The theme and language switches are inside the account menu, not on the bar.

## Docs

`content/docs/guide/layout.md` and `content/docs/layout/app-shell.mdx` now give the `AppShell` header as `h-12` (3rem / 48px). `guide-layout-sidebar-nav-doc.test.ts` pins `h-12`, the value the guide now states.

## Tests

The pin is `packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/consoleTopBar.height-12639.test.ts`, a source scan with 12 cases. It holds that:

- `CONSOLE_TOP_BAR` carries exactly one height utility, `h-12`, with no breakpoint variant;
- `CONSOLE_BELOW_TOP_BAR` equals the offset derived from the bar's `h-N`, and `UnifiedSidebar`'s `Sidebar` reads it;
- the census reaches every workspace package that can mount `AppHeader`, derived on each run from the `package.json` files, plus `packages/layout/src`. A positive control requires each listed frame to be in the scan;
- the set of sources that mount `AppHeader` equals the frame table, so a seventh frame fails;
- each app-shell frame's `header` reads the constant and sets no height of its own, and the `AppShell` and `/studio` literals equal the constant;
- no other source spells the bar's signature class, with a control that checks the signature recognizes the bar;
- no source offsets from a 56 px bar, with a control that checks the pattern matches the sidebar's old spelling.

**Ablation.** Each run went through `ablation-replace` in wrap mode, which records the anchor count on disk, proves the blob changed and restores with a proof that the blob matches HEAD. Run on `42985bd`:

| Mutation | Landed | Red cases | Restored |
|---|---|---|---|
| `OrganizationsLayout` back to the 56 px literal | anchor 1 to 0, blob `0ad0110` to `3efb6e1` | its frame case, and the no-copy case | blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty |
| `AppShell` literal `h-12` to `h-14` | anchor 1 to 0 | the `ConsoleLayout` frame case, and the layout guide pin | blob equals HEAD |
| `CONSOLE_TOP_BAR` `h-12` to `h-14` | anchor 1 to 0 | height, offset, `ConsoleLayout` frame and `/studio` frame (4 cases) | blob equals HEAD |
| `AppHeader` planted in `PreviewBadge.tsx` | anchor 1 to 0 | the seventh-frame case | blob equals HEAD |
| `UnifiedSidebar` back to `!top-14 !h-[calc(100svh-3.5rem)]` | anchor 1 to 0 | the offset case, and the no-56-px-offset case | blob equals HEAD |

The first try at the seventh-frame mutation was a no-op: its replacement contained its own anchor. The tool refused it, exited 1 and restored the file, and the run was redone with an anchor the replacement does not contain.

## Local gates (all on `42985bd`)

- Closure build: `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/console^...' --concurrency=2`, through the verify lock. This is the dependency closure of all three touched packages. Exit 0, 34 of 34 tasks.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/layout type-check`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0. A `--listFiles` count confirms its test project compiles the new test and module.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check`: exit 0.
- `pnpm exec vitest run` over the pin and the layout guide test: 2 files, 26 tests passed.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/layout/ packages/app-shell/ apps/console/ --maxWorkers=2`, through the verify lock: exit 0. `Test Files  1693 passed | 1 skipped (1694)`, `Tests  16235 passed | 9 skipped (16244)`. This covers the card's Acceptance 3 and the console's own tests.
- `pnpm check:changeset-claims`, `pnpm changeset:check`, `pnpm check:test-path-roots`, `pnpm check:spec-symbols`, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` and `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: exit 0.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the ten changed `.ts` and `.tsx` files: exit 0, 0 errors. The 44 warnings are on lines this change does not touch.

CI runs the full farm.

## Acceptance notes

- Screenshots at 1280 px of Home, an app and an organization page: NOT MEASURED in this run. The dispatch leaves that reading to the seat.
- The diff covers six bars and one offset, against the card's five bars. The sixth is the `/studio` landing (see above).
- No overlap with objectui#12605 or objectui#12615: both edit `AppHeader.tsx`, which this diff does not touch.
- Changeset: `.changeset/12639-console-bar-48.md`, `minor` for `@object-ui/layout`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/console`.
